C. LHHG desires to engage PSS to supply and manage certain categories of staff for its operations, and PSS desires to provide such services, all in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

**NOW THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

---

**1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION**

1.1 In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:

"**Client Premises**" means the LHHG establishments listed in Schedule A, as may be amended from time to time by written notice from LHHG.

"**Confidential Information**" means all information disclosed by one Party to the other, whether orally or in writing, that is designated as confidential or that reasonably ought to be considered confidential given the nature of the information or the circumstances of disclosure, including but not limited to business plans, customer data, financial information, and operational procedures.

"**Force Majeure**" means any event or circumstance not within the reasonable control of the affected Party, including but not limited to acts of God, flood, fire, explosion, epidemic, pandemic, strikes, lockouts, riots, civil commotion, war, or acts of government or regulatory authorities.

"**Personnel**" means the individuals supplied by PSS to LHHG pursuant to this Agreement.

"**Service Fee**" means the monthly fee payable by LHHG to PSS for the provision of Personnel, as calculated in accordance with Clause 6 and Schedule B.

"**Service Standards**" means the minimum performance and conduct standards set out in Schedule C.

"**Staffing Requirements**" means the number and categories of Personnel required by LHHG from time to time, as communicated by LHHG to PSS in accordance with Clause 3.

"**Term**" means the duration of this Agreement as set out in Clause 2.

The Lagos Harbour Staffing Contract, signed version 2.1, states that the contract_start_date is 2024-03-01. Record status: current.

---

**2. TERM**

2.1 This Agreement shall commence on 1 March 2024 (the "Commencement Date") and shall continue in full force and effect for a period of twenty-four (24) months, expiring on 28 February 2026, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions of Clause 12 (the "Term").

2.2 The Parties may, by mutual written agreement, extend the Term for such further period or periods as they may agree in writing.

---

**3. STAFFING REQUIREMENTS AND DEPLOYMENT**

3.1 LHHG shall communicate its Staffing Requirements to PSS in writing, specifying the number of Personnel required, the job categories, the Client Premises to which Personnel are to be deployed, and the expected duration of the assignment.

3.2 PSS shall use its best endeavours to fulfil LHHG's Staffing Requirements within five (5) working days of receiving a written request, provided that the request is received at least seven (7) days before the required deployment date. Requests received with shorter notice shall be accommodated on a best-efforts basis, and LHHG acknowledges that such requests may not be fully satisfiable.

3.3 PSS shall ensure that all Personnel supplied to LHHG:

(a) possess the requisite qualifications, skills, and experience for the position for which they are supplied;

(b) have undergone and passed all necessary background checks, including but not limited to criminal record verification and reference checks;

(c) are medically fit to perform their duties, as evidenced by a medical certificate issued within three (3) months prior to deployment;

(d) have received training in food safety, hygiene, and customer service, as applicable to their role; and
5.2 PSS shall ensure that all Personnel are lawfully entitled to work in the Federal Republic of Nigeria and hold all necessary permits, registrations, and certifications required by applicable law.

5.3 PSS shall be responsible for the payment of salaries, wages, allowances, pensions, and all statutory contributions (including but not limited to PAYE, the Employee Compensation Scheme, and the National Housing Fund) in respect of Personnel, and shall indemnify LHHG against any claim, loss, or liability arising from any failure to make such payments.

5.4 PSS shall maintain, at its own cost, adequate insurance cover, including employer's liability insurance and public liability insurance, in respect of Personnel and the provision of the Services. On request, PSS shall provide certificates of insurance to LHHG for inspection.

5.5 PSS shall comply, and shall procure that Personnel comply, with all applicable laws, regulations, and codes of practice, and with LHHG's reasonable policies and procedures notified to PSS from time to time, including any policies relating to health, safety, security, and conduct at the Client Premises.

5.6 PSS shall deal promptly and courteously with any complaints or queries raised by LHHG or by Personnel, and shall maintain a written record of any such complaints and the action taken.

**6. OBLIGATIONS OF LHHG**

6.1 LHHG shall provide PSS with accurate and timely information regarding its Staffing Requirements and shall notify PSS promptly of any changes to those requirements.

6.2 LHHG shall provide PSS and Personnel with reasonable access to the Client Premises during normal working hours, and with such facilities and information as PSS may reasonably require to perform the Services.

6.3 LHHG shall ensure that its premises, equipment, and systems comply with all applicable health and safety requirements, and that any risks to Personnel are identified and communicated to PSS in a timely manner.

6.4 LHHG shall not, without the prior written consent of PSS, directly or indirectly solicit or engage any Personnel for employment or engagement outside the scope of this Agreement during the Term and for a period of six (6) months thereafter. This restriction shall not apply where Personnel are engaged following a general recruitment or advertising campaign open to the public.

**7. VETTING AND QUALIFICATIONS**

7.1 PSS shall verify the identity, qualifications, and employment history of all Personnel before deployment and shall retain copies of all relevant documents for inspection.

7.2 Where a role requires a specific qualification or certification, PSS shall provide evidence of such qualification or certification to LHHG at least two (2) working days before the Personnel is deployed.

7.3 LHHG may, at its discretion, request that PSS remove any Personnel from an assignment if, in LHHG's reasonable opinion, the Personnel has failed to meet the required standards of conduct, performance, or professionalism. PSS shall comply with such a request promptly and shall use reasonable endeavours to provide a suitable replacement within five (5) working days.

**8. CONFIDENTIALITY**

8.1 Each Party shall keep confidential and shall not disclose to any third party any information of a confidential nature (including trade secrets, business plans, customer data, pricing, and any information marked as confidential) obtained from the other Party in connection with this Agreement, except:

(a) to the extent necessary to perform its obligations under this Agreement;

(b) to its professional advisers on a need-to-know basis;

(a) **Kitchen Porters** shall be responsible for:

(i) receiving, sorting, and storing incoming food deliveries;

(ii) washing, sanitising, and organising kitchen equipment, utensils, and crockery;

(iii) maintaining the cleanliness of the kitchen floor, surfaces, and waste disposal areas;

(iv) assisting the kitchen brigade with basic food preparation tasks as directed by the Head Chef or Sous Chef; and

(v) ensuring that all kitchen areas comply with LHHG's hygiene and food safety standards at all times.

(b) **Waiting Staff** shall be responsible for:

(i) greeting and seating guests in accordance with LHHG's service standards;

(ii) taking food and beverage orders accurately and transmitting them to the kitchen or bar;

(iii) serving food and beverages in a timely and professional manner;

(iv) clearing tables and resetting them for subsequent guests; and

(v) handling guest queries and complaints courteously, escalating any unresolved issues to the Shift Supervisor or Duty Manager.

PSS shall be solely responsible for the remittance of all such deductions and contributions to the relevant authorities and shall indemnify and hold harmless LHHG from and against any claim, penalty, fine, or liability arising from any failure by PSS to make such remittances on time or at all. 7.2 For the purposes of this Agreement, "Confidential Information" means all information (whether oral, written, or in electronic or other form) disclosed by or on behalf of one Party to the other Party in connection with this Agreement, including without limitation:

**9. PENALTIES FOR LATE DELIVERY**

**9.1 Penalty Rate**

Penalty clause 9.1 of the Kitchen Craft Supply Agreement sets penalty_rate_per_day_late at 0.02. Record status: current. For the avoidance of doubt, this rate shall be applied as a fraction of the Contract Price of the affected Equipment item or batch, and not of the aggregate value of all Equipment supplied under this Agreement.

**9.2 Application of Penalty**

9.2.1 If KCCE fails to deliver any Equipment item or batch by the corresponding Delivery Date set out in the Delivery Schedule (or any revised Delivery Date agreed in writing in accordance with Clause 3.3.2), and such failure is not attributable to a Force Majeure Event or to any act or omission of LHHG, then KCCE shall pay to LHHG a penalty calculated in accordance with Clause 9.3.

9.2.2 The penalty shall accrue on a daily basis from the day following the applicable Delivery Date until the earlier of:
(a) the date on which the Equipment is actually delivered and installed at the Delivery Location; or
(b) the date on which this Agreement or the relevant Purchase Order is terminated in accordance with Clause 9.5 or any other provision of this Agreement.

9.2.3 No penalty shall be applied for any delay in delivery where KCCE has delivered the Equipment to the Delivery Location within the Delivery Window specified in the Delivery Schedule, even if installation or commissioning extends beyond the Delivery Date, provided that such extension is solely due to conditions at the Delivery Location outside KCCE’s reasonable control.

**9.3 Calculation of Penalty**

9.3.1 The penalty for late delivery shall be calculated using the following formula:

Penalty = Contract Price of delayed Equipment × 0.02 × Number of Days of Delay

where “Number of Days of Delay” means the number of calendar days (including Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays) between the day following the applicable Delivery Date and the date of actual delivery and installation, subject to Clause 9.3.2.

9.3.2 For the purpose of calculating the penalty:
(a) any partial delivery of a batch shall be treated as a separate delivery, and the penalty shall be calculated only on the Contract Price of the Equipment actually delivered late;
(b) if LHHG accepts delivery of Equipment after the Delivery Date without prejudice to its rights under this Clause 9, the penalty shall continue to accrue until the date of such acceptance; and
(c) fractions of a day shall be disregarded, and the penalty shall be calculated on whole days only.

9.3.3 By way of illustration only, if the Contract Price of a delayed item is ₦4,500,000 and the delay is ten (10) days, the penalty shall be ₦4,500,000 × 0.02 × 10 = ₦900,000.

**9.4 Cap on Penalty**

9.4.1 The total penalty payable by KCCE under this Clause 9 in respect of any single Purchase Order shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Contract Price of the Equipment covered by that Purchase Order.

9.4.2 The total penalty payable by KCCE under this Clause 9 in respect of all Purchase Orders issued under this Agreement shall not exceed five percent (5%) of the aggregate Contract Price of all Equipment delivered under this Agreement.

9.4.3 Once the cap in Clause 9.4.1 or 9.4.2 is reached, LHHG may, in its sole discretion, either:
(a) accept the delayed Equipment and continue to pay the Contract Price less the penalty already accrued; or
(b) terminate the affected Purchase Order or this Agreement in accordance with Clause 9.5.

**4. PRODUCT LIST AND PRICE LIST** (continued)

4.1 The Products to be supplied under this Agreement, together with the applicable unit prices, are set out in Schedule 1 (Product List and Price List).

4.2 FCFD shall supply Products at the prices set out in Schedule 1, subject to adjustment in accordance with Clause 5.

4.3 LHHG shall place Orders for Products by email or such other means as the Parties may agree in writing. Each Order shall specify the Products, quantities, delivery date, and delivery location.

4.4 FCFD shall confirm acceptance of each Order within four (4) hours of receipt during Business Hours. If FCFD does not confirm acceptance within such period, the Order shall be deemed accepted.

4.5 LHHG may cancel or vary an Order at any time prior to FCFD's confirmation of acceptance, and thereafter only with FCFD's written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.

**5. PRICE ADJUSTMENT**

5.1 The prices set out in Schedule 1 shall remain fixed for the first three (3) months of the Initial Term. Thereafter, prices shall be adjusted on a quarterly basis in accordance with this Clause 5.

5.2 The price adjustment clause of the Fresh Coast Food Supply Contract uses price_adjustment_index as the National Bureau of Statistics Food Price Index. Record status: current. The National Bureau of Statistics Food Price Index (the "Index") is the index published monthly by the National Bureau of Statistics of Nigeria, reflecting changes in the prices of food items consumed by households in Nigeria. The current version of the Index, as published from time to time, shall be the reference index for the purposes of this Agreement.

5.3 The first adjustment shall take effect on 20 August 2024, and subsequent adjustments shall take effect on the 20th day of each third month thereafter (each an "Adjustment Date").

5.4 The adjusted price for each Product shall be calculated using the following formula:

Adjusted Price = Base Price × (Index at Adjustment Date ÷ Index at Commencement Date)

Where:

(a) "Base Price" means the price for the relevant Product set out in Schedule 1, as adjusted on any prior Adjustment Date;

(b) "Index at Adjustment Date" means the Index figure published for the month immediately preceding the Adjustment Date;

(c) "Index at Commencement Date" means the Index figure published for the month of May 2024.

5.5 FCFD shall notify LHHG in writing of any price adjustment not less than fourteen (14) days prior to the relevant Adjustment Date, setting out the calculation of the adjusted prices and the Index figures used. If FCFD fails to give such notice, the prices shall remain unchanged for that quarter.

5.6 If the Index ceases to be published, or is materially revised in a manner that affects the comparability of figures, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to agree a substitute index or a revised methodology. If the Parties fail to agree within thirty (30) days, either Party may refer the matter to arbitration in accordance with Clause 18.

5.7 LHHG may, by written notice to FCFD given not less than twenty-one (21) days before an Adjustment Date, elect to terminate this Agreement with effect from that Adjustment Date if the cumulative increase in prices since the Commencement Date exceeds fifteen percent (15%). Such termination shall be without prejudice to any rights accrued prior to the date of termination.

**6. DELIVERY**

6.1 FCFD shall deliver Products to the delivery location specified in each Order, which shall be a location within Lagos State unless otherwise agreed in writing.

6.2 Unless otherwise stated in an Order, deliveries shall be made between 05:00 and 09:00 hours WAT on the requested delivery date. FCFD shall notify LHHG of any anticipated delay of more than two (2) hours as soon as reasonably practicable.
